faq.titre: The most frequent questions find their answer here.

items.question: How much does the training cost?
items.reponse: The price depends on the path you choose — full programme, group session or individual session. The thirty-minute discovery call is free: the exact amount is confirmed to you there, before any commitment.

items.question: Do I need to know SAP Ariba already to start?
items.reponse: No. No SAP prerequisites are needed: the training starts from the fundamentals, and every module is put into practice.

items.question: Do I need my own SAP Ariba access?
items.reponse: This question is covered during the discovery call: the trainer tells you what you need before the first session.

items.question: Are the sessions recorded?
items.reponse: No. Every session is led live — that is the very format of the training. Video add-ons are being considered for a later stage.

items.question: How long do I have access to the materials?
items.reponse: Access to the materials lasts 6 months from the date of the training. Each module comes with its downloadable PDF handout, along with the corrected practical case.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate of attendance?
items.reponse: A certificate of attendance is issued at the end of the full learning path.

items.question: Can the training be funded (CPF, OPCO)?
items.reponse: Ask during the discovery call: your situation is reviewed and you are given the answer in writing before any enrolment.
